user.title: Daily Routine
user.description: Adds Daily Routine. Routines are created in the Daily Routine sidebar panel, room by room, from the rooms you already have in Home Assistant.

abort.single_instance: Daily Routine is already set up.

user.title: Add routine
user.description: Routines are made in the Daily Routine sidebar.

reconfigure.title: Edit {name}
reconfigure.description: Everything here is also in the Daily Routine sidebar, and changes show in both. Steps: one per line, for example light.turn_off | light.hall, or wait 30. Extra conditions: one per line, for example lock.front_door = unlocked, presence everyone away | person.a, person.b | zone.home, or sensors quiet 10 | binary_sensor.hall_motion.

data.name: Name
data.offset_minutes: Offset in minutes (for sunrise or sunset; negative is before)
data.room: Room (leave empty for the whole house)
data.sensors: Motion or occupancy sensors (for a room-is-quiet trigger)
data.clear_minutes: Quiet for (minutes, for a room-is-quiet trigger)
data.watch_entity: Device or to-do list to watch
data.watch_item: To-do item to watch for (leave empty for any item)
data.watch_states: States to watch for, separated by commas (for example on, or locked)
data.hold_minutes: Wait this many minutes before running (0 runs at once)
data.off_threshold: Turn back off below this level (optional)
data.catch_up_minutes: If missed after a restart, still run within (minutes, 0 = never)
data.repeat: Run every time (not just once a day)
data.skip_noop: Skip steps that are already done
data.notify_on_skip: Notify me when it is skipped
data.notify_on_health: Notify me when it needs attention (a device or list is missing or unavailable)
data.wait_when_unavailable: Wait for an unavailable to-do list or device to come back, then run
